comparison.objective: PR-1923 threads shock cord through a spring cord lock while depressing its button; the candidate sets a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1923 tests sustained button actuation coordinated with deformable threading and release to spring grip; the candidate tests rigid concentric tool seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1923 requires specified cord protrusion, spring-only retention, table rest, and released hands; the candidate requires a locked angle retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Holding open a spring passage during cord insertion does not measure calibrated screw adjustment or jam-nut locking.
